attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual Palari V2 character study

Primary request: Create one original Palari. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. A Palari is a small crafted ceramic vessel whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.

Selected design:
- identity: high-crested stone crescent with a low amber side reveal
- silhouette: slender asymmetric crescent with a finished architectural sweep, using a closed exterior sweep and never an upward-facing cavity
- crown: closed asymmetric upward sweep with a continuous exterior cap; no upward-facing cavity or open rim
- opening: one controlled side reveal following the silhouette
- pose: both rounded arms crossed calmly around the opening
- expression: quietly confident, conveyed only through calm eye posture, with no mouth
- exterior material: balanced warm medium-grey stoneware, clearly grey rather than brown
- characteristic color: warm amber, visually anchored to #C17A0B

Family invariants:
- one complete isolated figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark
- one dominant architecturally intentional side opening and no additional unrelated openings
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, amber iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy
- exact Palari seed mark on the lower body: four larger circular amber apertures at the corners of a compact vertical rectangle with two smaller amber apertures centered vertically between them; exactly six apertures total, not a grille
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges

Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
Composition: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; square composition, full figure and full base visible, centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve readable ceramic form and inner depth without neon glow.

Avoid: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim, fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, realistic hands, conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, demographic costume shorthand, multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, neon glow, robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, appliance details, random holes, more than one dominant opening, cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, antique distressing, cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, household appliances, generic mascot smiles, chibi proportions, horror, vacant doll eyes, an upward-facing cavity on a crescent, a circular aperture surrounding the face, text, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks.
attempts.review: Rejected: the body reads as a rounded teardrop or pod rather than a crescent, the amber opening surrounds and contains the face instead of remaining a low side reveal, and the seed lacks the required size hierarchy.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one square Palari IP mascot logo candidate derived from Image 1
Input image: Image 1 is identity reference only. Preserve its narrow high-crested stone crescent silhouette, one low amber side reveal separate from the face, two calm eyes, exactly two thick crossed arms, stable legless base, and exact small six-aperture seed. Do not preserve its studio scene, realistic stone material, lighting, shadows, or camera depth.

Create one highly simplified logo first and character second.
Subject: the source Palari normalized to one rounded continuous warm-ivory shell silhouette with a high blunt asymmetric crescent crest and curved open-side contour, one continuous low amber side aperture below and separate from the face, exactly two compact calm eye marks, and exactly two thick rounded crossed arm forms. The shell/aperture silhouette must be the primary identity; keep the six-aperture Palari seed as a tiny secondary family detail low on the body: four larger amber dots at rectangle corners plus two visibly smaller amber dots centered vertically, exactly six.

Composition: upright, emerging from and intentionally cropped only at the lower-left canvas corner; fill 75–85% of the square; never crop crest, eyes, opening, arms, or seed.
Complexity: 6–10 broad rounded structural forms; the six tiny seed cutouts are an explicit identity exception. Readable as a distinct black silhouette and recognizable at 32 × 32.

Color count: exactly three semantic colors total: warm ivory #E9E6DF for every shell and arm region, warm amber #C17A0B for the single side aperture plus eye marks and tiny seed, and deep navy #172333 only for the fully opaque edge-to-edge background. No other hue, gray, white, or black. Keep amber in one dominant continuous inner region; the tiny eye/seed reuses are required identity marks.
Style: flat-first vector-friendly geometry with extremely subtle continuous-gradient micro-volume only. One uninterrupted low-frequency same-family diffuse gradient within each large ivory/amber region, sharing an upper-left-to-lower-right light direction, spanning at least half each form; total lightness variation <= 0.08. Nearly flat at 32 px.

Forbid: illustration, scene, alcove, floor, texture, ceramic realism, clay, plastic, toy render, gloss, bevel, extrusion, cast shadow, contact shadow, rim light, discrete highlight patches, inner shadow blobs, hard shading bands, outlines, thin lines, sharp crest point, face inside the aperture, extra apertures, extra arms, hands, fingers, legs, feet, mouth, eyebrows, nostrils, text, watermark, border, frame, vignette, gradient background, transparency, rounded canvas corners, App icon mask.
attempts.review: Rejected: the seed contains seven circles and the navy background visibly vignettes, although the source-specific crescent, side reveal, crossed arms, and calm eyes remain clear.
